topic: The Psychology of FOMO: Why Chasing Multibaggers Destroys Wealth
teaching_objective: Learners will understand how FOMO, social proof and recency bias can push them into overvalued stocks, and will learn a simple pause-and-check process for making disciplined investment decisions.

slides.headline: Sab kama rahe hain… main kyun nahi?
slides.core_explanation:
• Social media par success stories baar-baar dikhai deti hain.
• Mind ko lagta hai ki opportunity abhi miss ho rahi hai.
• Isi urgency ko FOMO kehte hain.

slides.headline: FOMO ka engine: 3 biases
slides.core_explanation:
• Recency bias: recent winners future ka promise lagte hain.
• Social proof: sab kharid rahe hain, toh decision sahi lagta hai.
• Regret aversion: baad mein पछताने ka fear decision ko hijack karta hai.

slides.headline: Past multibagger = future guarantee nahi
slides.core_explanation:
• High growth ke saath high volatility bhi aa sakti hai.
• Valuation correction returns ko hurt kar sakta hai.
• Business execution, debt aur cash flow risks ignore nahi karne chahiye.

slides.headline: Loss ka maths zyada tough hota hai
slides.core_explanation:
• ₹100 se 50% girkar ₹50 bache.
• Wapas ₹100 hone ke liye 100% gain chahiye.
• Isliye downside ko ignore karna expensive ho sakta hai.

slides.headline: 24-hour pause: FOMO ka antidote
slides.core_explanation:
• Sudden rally ke baad turant order mat place karo.
• 24-hour cooling-off period rakho.
• Price chart ke bina business ko explain kar pa rahe ho?

• Valuation, debt aur cash flow.

slides.headline: Wealth speed se nahi, discipline se banti hai
slides.core_explanation:
• Multibagger chase karna strategy nahi hai.
• Quality, valuation aur allocation ko priority do.
• Missed opportunity se better hai avoidable loss se bachna.

caption:
Har rising stock opportunity nahi hota—andar se kabhi-kabhi woh sirf FOMO hota hai. 🚦

Past multibagger performance future returns ki guarantee nahi deti. Buy karne se pehle 24-hour pause, business quality, valuation, debt, cash flow, position size aur downside scenario check karein.

Wealth excitement se nahi, repeatable discipline se banti hai.
